paper_id: Wu et al. - 2015 - PhaseU Real-time LOS identification with WiFi
title: PhaseU: Real-time LOS identification with WiFi
motivation: NLOS propagation deteriorates communication and localization;现有方法因带宽限制无法在 commodity WiFi 上实时识别 LOS
problem_framing: 将 LOS 识别建模为二元假设检验,核心在于提取有效特征来区分 LOS 和 NLOS 条件
key_insight: 天线间相位差的方差在 NLOS 条件下更大,且加权多子载波可放大该差异
method_signature: 利用天线空间分集+子载波频率分集,提出 ρ 因子特征进行实时二元判决
evaluation_criteria: LOS detection rate, NLOS detection rate, ROC 曲线, 延迟(ms 级)
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 单天线相位方差不足以准确区分 LOS/NLOS,阈值敏感且无明显 gap
evidence_for_taste: none of existing approaches is directly feasible
variances in NLOS conditions are magnified
phase information is an excellent indicator
no clear gap can be found between the variances
both LiFi and Rician-K fail to identify
thinking_moves: 先发现单天线相位方差不足,再引入多天线相位差增强判别力
从 amplitude 统计假设分布转向 phase 无分布偏好的方差特征
把移动场景中连续运动分解为瞬时静止片段进行识别
借鉴 MIMO 空间分集思想但基于 commodity 设备实测验证而非仿真
cites_own_work: prior work on CSI amplitude features
